name: Wily Warrior — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Wily Warrior from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Wily Warrior (Story)" but are not part of the Wily Warrior entry, which is unchanged.

Quest (Roll a 1d4)
You were born and raised in a town surrounded and often besieged by orcs (and occasionally giants), and will defend it against all attackers.
Your awareness was honed to a knife’s edge by training in martial monasteries, and you wish to outdo every rival.
You steadfastly watch for spies and assassins seeking to undermine the leadership.
Foolish commanders have proven themselves temporary but relentless problems. You intend to give them a humiliating defeat that will finally put them in their place.
